question: The interior angle of a regular polygon is 156 ^circ . How many sides does this polygon have?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any regular polygon, the sum of an interior angle and an exterior angle is always 180°.

Exterior Angle = 180° − 156° = 24°

Number of sides = 360° ÷ Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ 24° = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Interior angle of a regular polygon = 156°

**Formula Used:**

Interior angle = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n

 

 

 

 

 156°
 24°
 Interior
 Exterior

**Calculations:**

⇒ 156° = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n

⇒ 156n = 180n − 360

⇒ 180n − 156n = 360

⇒ 24n = 360

⇒ n = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of all exterior angles of any convex polygon is always exactly 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Number of Diagonals

The total number of unique diagonals that can be drawn within an n-sided polygon is n(n − 3) ÷ 2.
